AuthMe Premium

Auto-login bridge for premium players using AuthMe, with proxy/Geyser-oriented workflows.

Security

  • Authentication
  • Premium support
  • Geyser

View on BuiltByBit

What it does

AuthMe Premium is described as an auto-login bridge for premium players using AuthMe, with proxy and Geyser-oriented workflows. Its tags — authentication, premium support, Geyser, proxy — place it at the network edge rather than in gameplay. The work is narrow: letting an account that already authenticated elsewhere reach the server without being asked to log in twice, in the proxy and Geyser setups its tags name.
